area: predict (verified + corrected): real-time prediction of a storm's final damage while it is in progress
verifier_verdict: fitter's additive damage model omits the remaining-value (prior-damage) effect; corrected here
split: fit seasons 1-400, holdout 401-600; every metric labelled hold is on 401-600
kernel: K(u) = (1 - u/2)^2 for u = d/R < 2, else 0; exposure E_s = sum over 2-s storm obs of 2 * I * K(d_s/R)

damage_model_remaining_value.form: added damage_pct_c (this storm) = sum_s w_s * cond_s * cap_c * (1 - exp(-k_c * E_s)); cond_s = remaining fraction of site s before this storm
damage_model_remaining_value.cond_update_after_each_final_report: for company c with final added damage D_c (pct): part_s = w_s*cond_s*(1-exp(-k_c*E_s,full)); cond_s -= (D_c/100) * part_s / sum(part) / w_s ; floor 0. Starts at 1.0 each season. PORT (1 site): cond = 1 - cumD/100 exactly.
damage_model_remaining_value.note: residual cross-company correlation drops from 0.4-0.75 (additive) to |r|<0.07 (RV): there is no hidden per-island factor

closure_model.form: site closed while I*K(d/R) > 0.237; H_c = sum_s w_s * closed seconds (2 s per obs)

features.obs_index: obs index t//2 is storm age t (verified contiguous 0..480 in all 1800 storms)
features.dso_rv: RV damage of exposure so far (obs ages <= t) with current cond
features.at_rv: mean over K=25 analogs (training storms 1-400 at the same age, self excluded) of RV damage of (E_so + E_future); analog distance = ((dx/sx)^2+(dy/sy)^2+(dv30x/svx)^2+(dv30y/svy)^2) + 2*[latest official outlook differs or analog has none, only if query has an advisory]; sx,sy,svx,svy = training SDs at that age; v30 = mean velocity over the last 30 s (or since formation); analog future = its obs at ages t+4, t+8, ..., 480 (dt 4 s), translated by (query pos - analog pos at t), R and I scaled by query/analog ratio at t
features.cone_rv: RV damage of E_so + exposure along the latest official cone path (linear through cone points with age > t, from current position, extrapolating the last segment), R held, I(a) = I_t for a<=420 and fades linearly to 0 at 480; 3x3 blur at offsets 0.7*spread in x,y with binomial weights 1-2-1; before the first advisory use constant-v30 persistence
features.at_H/cone_H/hso: same constructions for closure seconds of PORT, GRID, FERRY
features.hc/ol: latest official advisory with age <= t (zeros before age 30)

settlement_formulas_verified.D,H,L: season-cumulative damage pct, closure seconds, insured loss $M (D,L additive over storms; H from tracks)

combo_rv.form: settle_fair = a + b*house_t + c*ours_t (ours = RV3+hc -> settlement formulas, plug-in), fit seasons 1-400 round 3

timing.house_row_for_age_t: (60 + t)//2 in the round's market.csv block; house reacts ~4 s after news (jump at row for age 4)
